chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding
the fasting one who extracts his tooth, he said: No, nor should he bleed his mouth, nor should he brush with a wet stick.
ai.seo_question: Does extracting a tooth break the fast in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that tooth extraction does not invalidate the fast, provided the individual avoids excessive bleeding or swallowing significant moisture. It further advises against using a fresh (wet) siwak stick, reflecting the scholarly principle of avoiding actions that may lead to swallowing water or food particles, thereby preserving the integrity of the fast.
